objective: Define the patched/reviewed Verilator binary selection boundary for the next direct command-path native-invocation parse retry, without executing a new command or claiming native option support, sidecar execution, compare execution, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic GPU allocation, runtime/ABI change, raw full-state equality, or production LLM-serving throughput.

selection_reason.weakest_point: The previous native-invocation run used the local PATH Verilator 5.044 binary and therefore proved only that the local unpatched binary rejects --sim-accel. A retry must first select a reviewed patched binary with recorded build and parser-smoke provenance; otherwise another parse failure could be an environment selection problem rather than a native-invocation boundary result.
selected_because: the candidate binary was rebuilt from a clean Verilator v5.048 checkout with the current overlay patch
descriptor validation, git apply --check, actual apply, diff check, autoconf, configure, and make verilator_bin all exited 0 in the source run
the candidate binary accepted expanded --sim-accel sidecar-gpu 64x1 and 1x64 parser-only smoke cases
the candidate binary rejected selected negative and non-numeric --sim-accel-states/--sim-accel-steps cases
the candidate is stronger than the earlier reused compile-fix parser-behavior binary because it includes the parser integer-hardening rebuild evidence
the candidate remains a generated artifact and is not canonical source of truth

selected_patched_binary_candidate.verilator_root_env_reason: The generated checkout build is not installed; VERILATOR_ROOT must point at the generated checkout root so the binary can find built-in include files during a parser-only retry.

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_patched_binary_selection_gate
must_decide: whether the parser integer-hardening rebuilt binary is the correct patched binary candidate for the next native-invocation parse retry
whether generated artifact reuse is acceptable for the next retry or whether an equivalent rebuild must happen first
whether VERILATOR_ROOT setup is sufficiently mechanical and non-canonical
whether the retry should stay parser-only on an isolated smoke RTL before any sidecar stage is allowed
